//! A sample for structure tests.
//! Two container doc lines.

const std = @import("std");
const mem = std.mem;
const Allocator = @import("std").mem.Allocator;

/// A point.
/// With two doc lines.
pub const Point = struct {
    x: f32,
    y: f32 = 0,

    pub fn len(p: Point) f32 {
        return std.math.sqrt(p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y);
    }
};

pub const Color = enum { red, green };

const Shape = union(enum) {
    circle: f32,
    square: f32,
};

var counter: u32 = 0;

fn helper(items: []const u32) u32 {
    var sum: u32 = 0;
    for (items) |it| {
        if (it > 3) {
            sum += it;
        }
    }
    const v = blk: {
        break :blk switch (sum) {
            0 => 1,
            else => sum,
        };
    };
    return v;
}

test "helper sums" {
    const xs = [_]u32{
        1, 5,
        7,
    };
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(u32, 12), helper(&xs));
}
